result.summary: Several visual and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a misspelled search placeholder, and horizontal clipping on category chips and listing cards.

issues.description: Restaurant name under the third 'Fastest near you' card is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis or wrapping, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles use ellipsis overflow, flexible width, or multi-line clamp so full names remain discoverable (e.g. tooltip or full text on two lines).

issues.description: Search field placeholder is misspelled: 'Restarants, dishes, groceries'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: Category chip row and 'Fastest near you' cards are hard-clipped at the right edge with no clear fade/peek affordance that more content scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right-side padding/fade and partial next-item peek so horizontal scroll is obvious.

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is heavily cut off by the viewport/tab bar, which can feel broken if users don't realize the page scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset above the tab bar so the next card peeks more clearly and isn't flush against the nav.
